title: Only 4 out of 70+ projects made money: ship more because hit rate is ~5%
summary: Pieter Levels shares that only 4 of his 70+ projects ever made money and grew, meaning over 95% failed. His takeaway is that a ~5% hit rate is normal, so the way to win is to ship many projects.

principles.text: Expect most projects to fail; a ~5% hit rate is normal even for a successful maker.
principles.quote: 📉 >95% of everything I ever did failed

principles.text: Since hit rate is low, the answer is to ship more projects to get more chances at a winner.
principles.quote:
📈 My hit rate is only about ~5%

🚀 So...ship more

principles.text: Only a handful of many attempts end up making money and growing; success is concentrated in few projects.
principles.quote: Only 4 out of 70+ projects I ever did made money and grew
